title: Craft holed by gunfire over Los Alamos

tellings.quote: My only theory, and that's all it is, is perhaps that whole uh like I said earlier, may have been a a a weapon, a 50 caliber rifle, machine gun or whatever when it was flying over Los Alamos, and maybe mass decompression,

plain: Scott Ramsay, a researcher who studies a reported 1948 crash of an unknown craft in New Mexico, offers a guess on podcast host Jesse Michels' show about why it came down. He says it is only his theory, but perhaps someone fired a heavy weapon, like a 50 caliber machine gun, at the craft as it flew over Los Alamos, the New Mexico town where America's nuclear weapons research was based, and the hole caused a sudden loss of air pressure inside. If true, it would explain both the crash and what happened to whoever was on board.
